description: The Decarbonization Chart shows the historical and forward-looking cumulative emissions rate % change compared to 1 or 2 portfolio emission reduction targets in a time series. This enables monitoring of the progress of the portfolio emissions reductions against the portfolio targets.
title: Decarbonization
imageDescription: This decarbonization chart shows the cumulative decarbonization rate for portfolio SNP500 compared to 2 portfolio targets in 2030 and 2050.
setUpRequirements: After adding this chart, click on the settings gear icon to customize.

Emissions metric: Revenue Intensity, EVIC Intensity, Financed Emissions, Intensity $/GDP (Sovereign Issuers), Intensity $/GDP PPP (Sovereign Issuers), Intensity Per Capita (Sovereign Issuers), Intensity $/Sov Debt (Sovereign Issuers).
Emissions Start Year: Select the year the data starts on the chart based on whether you want to view historical data, forward-looking data, or both.
Aggregation Method: Delta Notional MV, Weighted Average, Sum or None.
Climate Scenario: Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), NGFS Current Policies (CPS), Blended Scenario.
Issuer Emissions Targets: With targets, Without targets, With Credibility Framework.
Set Portfolio Targets (Up to 2): Reduction %, Start Year, Target Year.
